item: Simple mode PR 2: World, Numbers and Add a source views
summary: World ranks countries by coverage from the local map aggregate (codes shown, names on hover) and a click scopes Read and the summary; Numbers reads stored market series and climate datasets with fetch dates and sends fetching to the full view's consent gate; Add a source normalises the host, checks domain plus feed for duplicates and makes the one write; At a glance names the sources a set is covered from, with a partial mark at the cap; strings x12.
